name: Gastly
description: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the target while crying out in a startling fashion.

moves.name: Poison Gas
moves.description: The user sprays a cloud of toxic gas that poisons the target.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: The user attacks with relentless intensity. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid to inflict damage. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target drowsy.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target to deal damage. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.
